title: Independently audit normalized Gaussian scalar enclosures and precision
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR4205's completed normalized Gaussian verifier explicitly uses the producer's interval backend for its finer references. This adds an implementation-independent certified scalar oracle and checks every scalar preparation in the nine saved cases. It also independently derives the existing all-rational/all-precision scalar width and termination implication from the actual source, including its coefficient and conditioning-denominator precision rules.

The frozen arcsine/negative-Taylor oracle certifies 128 unique inputs. Its intervals lie inside all 186 actual source intervals; 43 quantized offsets, 61 finite offsets, scalar reciprocal and finite-tail budgets pass. Three calibrated scalar/billing mutations reject. The original scalar argument and normalized construction remain credited to their authors. This is a scoped acceptance audit, with no full circuit or matrix-inverse theorem admission and no new κ.

## Task and overlap

Canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority 7. Frozen completed normalized source: PR4205 `66b95cc916552f487203be14fd99a7aea0bdd78e`; unchanged source exports are retained in public ancestor `607924844afbfb907c835dbf47bc2ac1da00557f`. [Claim and boundaries](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19078895).

`uniform-transfer-audit` is refined to this one actual scalar-caller implication. The fresh round found the intended Gaussian bridge completed, so it selects independent backend acceptance instead. The author's active raw/common-reference extension and prior PR4209 Schur theorem are excluded. Initial 328 and submission 333 open/draft bodies plus live hub/topic/board were checked; broader coverage is partial and not evidence of novelty.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library, six normal/strict-optimized commands:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-scalar-backend-audit
```

The independent oracle's mathematical core/proof and 36 self-tests were frozen before source-generated queries, and it never viewed source outputs. Source integration deliberately imports unchanged real modules, logs delegated exponential calls and executes the retained Tsec expression; it does not call compile/compile_root, construct Full, run admission or execute gates. The 512-bit incoming precision is a constructor parameter here. Source licenses, raw CRLF and two independence freezes are preserved. Exact-public-head cold/hosted replay and unchanged-byte receipts are recorded in the final Discussion handoff.

## Credit

Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml supplied the normalized interface and width argument, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Mason Hale/PR2313 supplied unchanged interval routines and earlier dense execution; retain its NOTICE. Credit Jeremy Kothe/IdeaOuter, Vlado Vojdanovski/PR1673, Chafik Boukhalfa, Cinna Davis and the retained Gaussian lineage. James Reed's prior finite audit at the earlier source head remains distinct. Classical series/interval methods are not new general mathematics. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for a separately implemented oracle, source integration and separate written/code reviews; no human/formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

Refresh the author's active raw/common-reference claim, then select one completed unclaimed scaling/reference implication at a separately pinned head. Full leading-section/circuit proof admission, efficient scalar setup, raw gauges/common reference, physical delivery/tape, supplier/native outer and multiplication obligations remain open. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or selected-frontier change.
